description: Ministry of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs -  Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1395/15 of 01.06.2005, adding "3.  Department of  English Language Teaching" to the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to a university's structure under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1)) to amend the schedule establishing the Uva Wellassa University by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it a legal/regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
